design.method: Subdivide each original triangle by shared edge midpoint 3 times; protect all original front vertex indices j=0,1 and entire z=0 ring, propagate protection to midpoint of any two protected vertices. Interpolate section-center XY at vertex z, subtract toward center horizontally only. Field = sum A*exp(-((x-cx)^2+(y-cy)^2+(z/H-h)^2)/(2*s^2)) + rough_amp*(.5+.5*sin(29*x+17*y+11*z)*cos(13*x-23*y+19*z)). Multiply by clamp((y-front_y(z))/.1,0,1)*clamp(z/.14,0,1), clamp to .32 times radial distance, protected=0. No change to height, entire original front triangles, base and convex reserve. Exact face winding, minimum face areas and posterior cutter clearance checked. Authored values are not inferred physical dimensions from sprites.
